description: Converting a SAS DATA step (KEEP/DROP/RENAME, WHERE/IF, computed columns, RETAIN/BY accumulation) to vectorized pandas.

data_step_basics.title: A DATA step is a row-by-row loop; most of it vectorizes into pandas assignments and masks.
rule: A DATA step is a row-by-row loop. Most vectorize cleanly in pandas; keep RETAIN/accumulator logic explicit.
`WHERE` filters using the stored value; a subsetting `IF` filters during the step. Both -> boolean mask `df[mask]`.
`IF cond THEN a = x; ELSE a = y;` -> `np.where(cond, x, y)` or `df.loc[mask, "a"] = x`.
New columns computed from others are plain assignments: `df["z"] = df["a"] + df["b"]`.
`RETAIN` + `BY` accumulation -> `groupby(...).cumsum()` / `.cumcount()` / a manual scan when order-dependent.
Preserve original column names and case so downstream QC aligns.
pitfalls: Order-dependent RETAIN logic does not always vectorize; fall back to a manual scan in row order when needed.
